name: spend-objective-pay-first
description: Playtest 6 pbd387 (bot 1da6c62): Alice scored Amass Wealth from Imperial's Score A Public list, the bot scored it at once and only then asked for the payment; the game ended (2 VP) on the unpaid score. Fix (bot fuzz-triage-2, ObjectiveSpendService): a spend objective (Erect a Monument, Sway the Council, Amass Wealth, Found a Golden Age, Manipulate Galactic Law, Hold Vast Reserves; Lead From the Front / Galvanize when the pools can share it) is paid first; the payment's Score option (payment.spend context poscore, value.objectiveCost) scores it and is refused until what was spent covers it (each planet counts resources or influence). Base: pinned pbd387 saves 294 (+295: the Score A Public list). Sol holds Jord 4/2, Lodor 3/1 and 10 trade goods. Needs bot fuzz-triage-2 (FAILS on 1da6c62: step 1 scores at once).
